description: §6.7.4 (S447) a `${ when @n changes { @hits = @hits + 1 } }` in an `<each>` row body WRITES a reactive cell — under S447 that is E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE, and the keyword spelling also carries W-WHEN-EFFECT-DEPRECATED. Migrated S449: this case used to pin the row-body drop (`g-when-changes-in-each-row-body-dropped`) through the write, which S447 made an error; that pin moved to each/when-changes-in-row-body-no-write.
rationale: §6.7.4 "The retiring keyword form": "During the window a `when … changes { }` statement IS an `<effect>`: … and **the same no-write rule** — a writing `when` body is E-EFFECT-WRITES-STATE in the bootstrap now, not at the end of the window. **RULED S447.**"; Normative Statements: "`when … changes { }` SHALL be accepted during its §63 window as a spelling of `<effect>` with identical semantics, with W-WHEN-EFFECT-DEPRECATED at every site." Provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "accept and your rec (d)" (item 1: the no-write rule applies to the legacy spelling immediately).
